newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Letter bomb explodes in Vienna.
newsitem.headline: Letter bomb explodes in Vienna.

text.p: A letter bomb sent to an unidentified woman exploded in Vienna on Monday but no one was injured, police said.
The woman became suspicious of the package and informed police who took the device away just before it exploded, they said.
Austrian news agency APA said the recipient was a 50-year-old woman but gave no further details.
A bomb disposal expert was called to the scene in the working class district of Favoriten in the east of the city to deal with the device, the agency said.

No group immediately claimed responsibility for sending the device but the so-called Bajuwarian Liberation Army (BLA) has admitted sending more than a score of letter bombs in the past three years. Police have also linked the group to the murder of four gypsy men in February last year.
The shadowy BLA is believed to be a group which hankers after an ancient German-speaking zone, linking Bavaria with the Alps and Danube region.
